note: Made by the steps in TV_PICTURES.md: the chapter is split into sections that each carry one deep meaning ("sections"), 10 picture ideas are written for each, the top two for each picture are made and the better is chosen by eye (2026-11-22, 40 trial pictures). Wide pictures only (1920x1088); the "tall" names are kept for the day tall pictures are switched back on. Each scene starts at the first word of its verse. The important part of every picture sits in the upper two thirds, clear of the words. God is not pictured and Jesus, the disciples and the crowd are not portrayed as biblical people: the story is shown through ordinary people and things of today, and the sea crossing through an ordinary rowing boat.
method: Second method, asked for by Obay on 2026-11-21 after the sentence-by-sentence pictures did not connect: (1) split the chapter into sections that each carry one deep meaning, written as one plain sentence; (2) write 10 different picture ideas for each section; (3) judge them: which shows the deep meaning most truly, then which a watcher understands at once while hearing the words, then which is most engaging; (4) make the top two for each picture slot as real pictures ("candidates") and choose by eye. A section has one or two pictures.

scenes.principle: A large crowd followed him because they saw the signs he did for the sick.
scenes.shows: A long stream of people, some of them sick or lame, walking up a grassy hillside above a lake.
scenes.prompt: Seen from behind and a little above, a long stream of ordinary people of every age walks up a wide green grassy hillside above a large lake: a man on crutches, an old woman leaning on her grown son's arm, a girl in a wheelchair being pushed, families carrying small children, all heading the same way up the slope toward the top of the hill. Bright clear midday light, blue lake and far hills behind.

scenes.principle: All they could find was a little boy's five barley loaves and two fish: what are these for so many?
scenes.shows: A small boy's hands offering five small rolls and two small fish, with a huge crowd behind.
scenes.prompt: Close view of a small boy of about seven, seen from the chest down, holding out in both hands a small cloth bundle opened to show five little round barley bread rolls and two small dried fish. Behind him, out of focus, a huge crowd of people fills a grassy hillside all the way to the top of the frame. Soft overcast daylight.

scenes.principle: He gave thanks and shared out the loaves and fish, and everyone ate as much as they wanted.
scenes.shows: A hillside full of people sitting in groups on the grass, all eating bread and fish, contented.
scenes.prompt: A wide green hillside covered with people sitting in groups on thick grass, families and friends, every one of them eating bread and fish and smiling, baskets of bread being passed from group to group. Soft golden afternoon light, a lake glimpsed beyond. A sense of plenty and contentment.

scenes.principle: The leftover pieces were gathered so that nothing would be lost, and they filled twelve baskets.
scenes.shows: Twelve baskets full to the brim with broken bread standing in a row on the grass.
scenes.prompt: Twelve woven baskets, each full to the brim with broken pieces of bread, stand in a neat row across a grassy hillside after a meal, the grass pressed flat where a crowd has sat. Calm late-afternoon light with long soft shadows, a lake beyond.

scenes.principle: They were about to seize him to make him king, and he withdrew again onto the mountain alone.
scenes.shows: A crown lying unclaimed on a rock beside a mountain path that climbs on alone.
scenes.prompt: A simple gold crown lies unclaimed on a flat rock beside a narrow mountain path; the path climbs on past it, empty, up into high cool evening clouds. Quiet blue evening light.

scenes.principle: In the dark, on a sea roused by a great wind, without him, the disciples rowed and were afraid.
scenes.shows: At night on a rough lake, a small rowing boat with people pulling hard at the oars, afraid.
scenes.prompt: At night on a wind-whipped lake, a small wooden rowing boat with five people in rain jackets pulling hard at the oars, spray breaking over the bow, their faces strained and afraid, lit by a single lantern in the boat. Dark clouds and high waves all round. The only people are the ones in the boat.

scenes.principle: 'It is I; do not fear', and at once the boat was at the land they were heading for.
scenes.shows: The same small rowing boat resting with its bow on a calm shore at first light, the water still.
scenes.prompt: A small wooden rowing boat rests with its bow drawn up on a calm sandy shore at first light, its oars laid down inside, the lake behind it smooth as glass, a clear pale sky. Peaceful, still and safe.

scenes.principle: The crowd climbed into boats and crossed the sea, seeking him.
scenes.shows: People hurrying along a lakeside jetty to climb into small boats, looking out across the water.
scenes.prompt: On a wooden lakeside jetty a crowd of ordinary people hurries to climb into small boats, some already pushing off, others pointing across the water to the far shore. Bright morning light, blue water.

scenes.principle: They sought him for the loaves that filled them; do not work for the food that perishes but for the food that lasts.
scenes.shows: Three loaves on a board: one fresh, one dry and cracked, one covered in mould.
scenes.prompt: On a long wooden board, three loaves of bread in a row: the first fresh and golden, the second dry and cracked, the third covered in grey-green mould. Plain daylight from a window on a kitchen table.

scenes.principle: They asked for a sign like the manna their fathers ate in the wilderness.
scenes.shows: A desert at dawn with a thin white layer on the ground and a woven basket half full beside it.
scenes.prompt: A woven basket half full of small white flakes sits on desert ground that is covered with a thin layer of the same white flakes, like frost, in pale dawn light, the desert stretching away to distant hills.

scenes.principle: It is my Father who gives you the true bread from heaven, which gives life to the world.
scenes.shows: A father's hands handing a warm loaf of bread down into a small child's reaching hands.
scenes.prompt: Seen over a father's shoulder, his strong hands hand a warm round loaf of bread down into a small child's eagerly reaching hands at a kitchen table; the child's face is lit with joy. The father's face is not shown. Bright morning light from a window.

scenes.principle: I am the bread of life; whoever comes to me will never hunger, and I will never drive him out.
scenes.shows: A warm open doorway at night, bread on the table inside, a weary traveller welcomed in.
scenes.prompt: At night, a front door stands wide open and warm light pours out; inside, a table is laid with bread. A weary traveller with a backpack, seen from behind, stands on the step as an arm reaches out from inside the door to welcome him in. Cool blue night outside, golden light within.

scenes.principle: I will lose none of those the Father has given me, but raise them up on the last day.
scenes.shows: Fresh green shoots rising out of dark earth in a field at sunrise.
scenes.prompt: Close to the ground, countless fresh green shoots rise up out of dark, moist earth, fresh and strong, a field stretching behind them. Early morning light.

scenes.principle: They grumbled: is this not Joseph's son, whose father and mother we know?
scenes.shows: Small-town neighbours standing in a street with arms crossed, muttering with sideways, sceptical looks.
scenes.prompt: In a small-town street, a group of neighbours stand together with arms crossed, muttering to each other with sideways, sceptical looks and frowns, one of them shaking his head. Plain overcast daylight.

scenes.principle: No one can come to me unless the Father who sent me draws him.
scenes.shows: A father's hand gently leading a small child's hand along a garden path toward home.
scenes.prompt: Close view of a father's large hand gently holding a small child's hand and leading the child along a garden path toward a house with a lit window. Only hands and arms of the father. Soft evening light.

scenes.principle: I am the living bread; the bread I give is my flesh, for the life of the world.
scenes.shows: Two hands breaking a large round loaf, many hands of every age and colour reaching in to receive pieces.
scenes.prompt: Two hands break a large round loaf of bread in half in the upper middle of the frame, and all around it many hands of people of every age and skin colour reach in to receive pieces. Warm soft daylight.

scenes.principle: Unless you eat and drink of him you have no life in you; his flesh is true food and his blood true drink.
scenes.shows: A tired, gaunt hiker eating bread with both hands, eyes closed in relief, strength returning.
scenes.prompt: A tired, gaunt hiker sits on a rock on a mountain trail eating a piece of bread with both hands, eyes closed in relief, colour returning to his face. Clear midday light.

scenes.principle: Whoever feeds on him remains in him and he in them, and lives because of him, as he lives because of the Father.
scenes.shows: A tree with deep roots beside a stream in dry country, green while the land around is brown.
scenes.prompt: A broad tree with deep roots reaching into a small clear stream stands green and full of leaves in a dry, brown country. Bright clear midday light.

scenes.principle: This word is hard: many of his disciples went back and no longer walked with him.
scenes.shows: An open-air gathering where most of the chairs are now empty and people walk away down the slope.
scenes.prompt: An open-air gathering on a grassy hillside: most of the many rows of folding chairs are now empty, and people walk away down the slope in twos and threes with their backs turned, only a few still sitting. Overcast grey afternoon light.

scenes.principle: 'Do you also want to go?' To whom would we go? You have words of eternal life.
scenes.shows: A small group of friends standing together on an empty road, not following the crowd walking away in the distance.
scenes.prompt: A small group of friends stands together on an empty road, not following the crowd walking away in the distance. Soft evening light.
